title: Antibiotic discovery against Piscirickettsia salmonis using a combined in silico and in vitro approach.
authors: Beltran, Jorge F; Yanez, Alejandro; Herrera-Belen, Lisandra; Contreras, Fernanda Parraguez; Blanco, Jose A; Flores-Martin, Sandra N; Zamorano, Mauricio; Farias, Jorge G
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和体外实验筛选针对Piscirickettsia salmonis DNA旋转酶GyrA亚基的抗生素，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合域对接，但对象为细菌酶而非TF-DNA体系，且无AI或MD等深度建模，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: Piscirickettsia salmonis is one of the main pathogens causing considerable economic losses in salmonid farming. The DNA gyrase of several pathogenic bacteria has been the target of choice for antibiotic design and discovery for years, due to its key function during DNA replication. In this study, we carried out a combined in silico and in vitro approach to antibiotic discovery targeting the GyrA subunit of Piscirickettsia salmonis. The in silico results of this work showed that flumequine (-6.6 kcal/mol), finafloxacin (-7.2 kcal/mol), rosoxacin (-6.6 kcal/mol), elvitegravir (-6.4 kcal/mol), sarafloxacin (-8.3 kcal/mol), orbifloxacin (-7.9 kcal/mol), and sparfloxacin (-7.2 kcal/mol) are docked with good affinities in the DNA binding domain of the Piscirickettsia salmonis GyrA subunit. In the in vitro inhibition assay, it was observed that most of these molecules inhibit the growth of Piscirickettsia salmonis, except for elvitegravir. We believe that this methodology could help to significantly reduce the time and cost of antibiotic discovery trials to combat Piscirickettsia salmonis within the salmonid farming industry.
abstract_zh: Piscirickettsia salmonis 是导致鲑科鱼类养殖业重大经济损失的主要病原体之一。多种病原细菌的DNA旋转酶（DNA gyrase）因其在DNA复制过程中的关键功能，多年来一直是抗生素设计与发现的首选靶点。在本研究中，我们采用结合计算机模拟（in silico）与体外（in vitro）的方法，针对Piscirickettsia salmonis的GyrA亚基进行抗生素发现。本研究的计算机模拟结果显示，氟甲喹（flumequine，-6.6 kcal/mol）、非那沙星（finafloxacin，-7.2 kcal/mol）、罗索沙星（rosoxacin，-6.6 kcal/mol）、埃替格韦（elvitegravir，-6.4 kcal/mol）、沙拉沙星（sarafloxacin，-8.3 kcal/mol）、奥比沙星（orbifloxacin，-7.9 kcal/mol）和司帕沙星（sparfloxacin，-7.2 kcal/mol）以良好的亲和力对接在Piscirickettsia salmonis GyrA亚基的DNA结合域中。在体外抑制实验中，观察到除埃替格韦外，这些分子中的大多数能抑制Piscirickettsia salmonis的生长。我们相信，这种方法有助于显著减少针对鲑科鱼类养殖业中Piscirickettsia salmonis的抗生素发现试验的时间和成本。
